note: Maps the Grade-3 images generated for the OLD single-file app onto this app's stems. Two things decide whether an old picture survives. (1) Does its SUBJECT match a scene this script actually plays? The old app had a 3-beats-per-level model and let each level roam to a second location; this app's 10-scene spine is anchored in the bedroom studio and only leaves it three times. (2) Does it argue with the running app — a view count the app contradicts, a real brand mark, or the word the story is built on hiding? READABLE TEXT IS NOT A REASON TO DROP ANYTHING (Koki's ruling, 2026-07-28): in a story about a channel, the words on the screen ARE the beat, and several of the strongest images here are nothing but a phone with a message on it.
